c49616277a63e282.description:
As an Associate Backend Developer at Desnor Destination, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects that push the boundaries of technology. If you are passionate about backend development and have a strong grasp of Java, PHP, MySQL, HTML, Python, MongoDB, Django, Node.js, Express.js, REST API, and Bubble.io, then this is the perfect role for you.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Collaborate with the development team to design and implement backend solutions for our travel platform.
2. Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code using a variety of programming languages and frameworks.
3. Develop and optimize database schemas to ensure seamless data integration and retrieval.
4. Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to improve overall code quality.
5. Work closely with frontend developers to integrate backend functionalities and ensure a smooth user experience.
6. Implement and maintain RESTful APIs to facilitate communication between different systems and services.
7. Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and technologies in backend development to drive innovation and improve our platform's performance.

If you are a motivated and skilled backend developer looking to make a significant impact in the travel industry, then we want to hear from you. Join our dynamic team at Desnor Destination and take your career to new heights.

c43ad1635617d996.description: MTX) is currently hiring for the position of Financial Analyst with strong expertise in core financial focus areas. The ideal candidate will analyze financial performance, identify key business drivers and variances, develop forecasts and scenario analyses, and provide actionable insights to support informed decision-making. This role will partner closely with internal stakeholders and business teams to strengthen financial controls, improve reporting processes, maintain KPI dashboards, support month-end close and audit requirements, and enhance overall financial visibility and operational efficiency. MTX is a global technology consulting firm that enables organisations to modernise through digital transformation. With data as the new currency, MTX helps transform long-term strategy with outcomes in mind around happiness, health and the economy. MTX improves decision-making with speed and quality by partnering with leading cloud technologies. MTX provides expertise across various platforms and technologies, including Microsoft, Google Cloud, Salesforce, artificial intelligence/machine learning, data integration, data governance, data quality, analytics, visualization, and mobile technology. The Financial Analyst is expected to execute the following responsibilities: Financial Planning, Analysis & Forecasting: Lead and support monthly financial planning and analysis, including revenue accruals, forecasting, and project profitability analysis. Analyze actual performance versus budget and forecast, identify key variances, and provide clear explanations of business drivers, trends, and performance gaps. Develop and evaluate financial forecasts, budgets, and scenario analyses based on changing business conditions and management requirements. Identify opportunities to strengthen internal controls, financial reporting, and business processes, and implement improvements to enhance efficiency and mitigate financial risk. Support the communication and implementation of changes to business practices, financial processes, and procedures, including training internal employees where required. Support the development and maintenance of financial dashboards and management reports, including key performance indicators (KPIs) and critical balance sheet metrics. Prepare, analyze, and review financial information and management presentations for periodic Executive Leadership Team reviews. Perform ad-hoc financial and business analysis and provide actionable insights to improve the quality and effectiveness of management decision-making. Month-End Close, Audit & Compliance: Provide support for month-end close and financial reporting activities, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery of financial information. Liaise with relevant teams to support audit, compliance, and statutory requirements, ensuring timely availability and accuracy of required financial information. Collaborate proactively with internal stakeholders and business partners to understand financial requirements, manage expectations, and deliver relevant insights and solutions. Identify emerging financial and operational trends and proactively communicate potential risks, opportunities, and recommended actions to relevant stakeholders. Chartered Accountant (CA) with 12 years of experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, OR CA Inter with 68 years of experience in Financial Planning & Analysis. Strong expertise in core financial focus areas: Financial Planning & Analysis, Forecasting & Budgeting, Revenue Accruals, Project Profitability, Management Reporting, Variance Analysis, Internal Controls, KPI Dashboards, Audit & Compliance, and Business Partnering. Proven capability in analyzing financial performance variances, developing scenario analyses, and delivering actionable financial insights. Ability to identify operational risks/opportunities, support change management, and drive process improvements. Group Medical Insurance (Family Floater Plan - Self + Spouse + 4 Dependent Children) Maternity cover upto two children Cashless & Reimbursement facility Access to free online doctor consultation Personal Accident Policy (Disability Insurance) - Accidental Death and Permanent Total Disability is covered up to 100% of Sum Insured Permanent Partial Disability is covered as per the scale of benefits decided by the Insurer Temporary Total Disability is covered Optional Food Wallet (up to Rs. Offered as a tax saver component Part of the special allowance component in the CTC Professional Development opportunities through various MTX-sponsored certifications on multiple technology stacks, including Salesforce, Microsoft, Google Cloud, AWS & other .

c4e12ea794a7200d.description: Company Description Scapa Industrial is part of Mativ Holdings, a global provider of engineered materials and solutions serving a wide range of industrial and specialty markets. The company focuses on high-performance adhesive tapes and bonding products used in sectors such as automotive, construction, electronics, and general industrial applications. As a member of Mativ Holdings, Scapa Industrial benefits from a broad international footprint, technical expertise, and a collaborative culture. Team members work in a results-oriented environment that values safety, customer focus, and continuous improvement. The organization offers opportunities for professional growth and cross-functional collaboration across regions and business units.Role Description The Area Sales Manager is a full-time, remote role responsible for driving sales growth and managing customer relationships within an assigned territory. Day-to-day activities include identifying new business opportunities, managing a sales pipeline, and conducting virtual and on-site meetings with distributors, OEMs, and end users. The role involves presenting product solutions, preparing quotations, negotiating pricing and contracts, and collaborating with internal teams such as technical, customer service, and supply chain to ensure timely delivery and customer satisfaction. The Area Sales Manager will analyze market trends, track competitor activity, and provide regular sales forecasts and performance reports to leadership. This position also includes participating in industry events, training customers on product applications, and supporting strategic initiatives to expand market share.Qualifications Strong territory management, account management, and business development skills, with proven experience meeting or exceeding sales targets.Ability to conduct customer needs assessments, present technical or product solutions, and manage the sales cycle from lead generation to closing.Experience in industrial, manufacturing, or engineered materials markets; knowledge of adhesives, tapes, or related products is beneficial.Solid skills in sales forecasting, pipeline management, and use of CRM tools to track opportunities and customer interactions.Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at multiple levels.Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, including interpreting market data and customer feedback to inform sales strategies.Comfort working remotely, managing time effectively, and traveling within the assigned territory as needed.Bachelors degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in sales.Proficiency with standard business software (e.g., Microsoft Office suite, online meeting platforms) and digital collaboration tools.Commitment to ethical business practices, safety, inclusion, and a customer-centric mindset.

c443366dbf04e2de.description: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. Xometry is seeking a visionary and results-oriented Principal Product Leader to define and lead the long-term product vision, strategy, and execution for a key global platform critical to Xometry’s success (e.g., Buyer Experience, Partner Experience, Pricing , Quality, Sourcing, etc.). This role is a product leadership position responsible for maximizing profitable growth and driving digital transformation through customer-centric and AI-driven solutions. You will be instrumental in elevating product development practice, influencing cross-functional leaders, and ensuring our marketplace products deliver measurable business value at scale. Also, as a founding Product Manager for Xometry’s India PDT team, you will help establish product practices, build cross-region trust and collaboration, and foster a culture of innovation and execution as the organization scales. **How You'll Contribute:** **AI Driven Product Management** * Drive AI-Enabled Software Development: Champion the adoption of AI across the SDLC, identifying and scaling innovative ways to accelerate product development, improve engineering productivity, and increase software quality across the organization. **Product Strategy & Vision** * Define and own the multi-year strategic product vision and roadmap for the assigned domain, ensuring alignment with Xometry's overarching business objectives and aggressive growth plans. * Lead the translation of high-level business goals into actionable product plans, balancing immediate tactical wins with visionary, long-term initiatives. * Spearhead comprehensive market research, competitor analysis, and continuous user feedback loops to ensure product decisions are grounded in deep user understanding and competitive intelligence. **Leadership** * Serve as the executive-level product leader and communicator for your domain, influencing and aligning strategy with C-level stakeholders, business unit leaders, and cross-functional partners. * Elevate the product development practice across the organization by establishing and championing best practices for roadmapping, feature rollout strategies, and governance. **Execution & Outcomes** * Drive the successful execution of complex product initiatives across multiple teams, managing cross-functional dependencies, and managing the product lifecycle from ideation to post-launch iteration. * Champion a rigorous, data-driven approach by defining and monitoring Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to track success, measure impact, and continuously refine the experience. * Proactively identify and champion AI-driven business opportunities, leveraging machine learning and advanced analytics to enhance product features, automate processes, and drive competitive advantage. * Partner with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Content, and other teams to deliver scalable solutions, experimentation frameworks, and measurable business outcomes. **Found and Scale Xometry’s India Product Development Center** * Serve as a founding Product Manager for Xometry’s India PDT team, establishing product practices, enabling global trust, and helping build a high-performing organization. **What You'll Bring to Xometry:** * 12+ years of progressive product management experience, with a significant portion in a strategic or principal/director-level role. * Proven track record of defining, successfully launching, and scaling complex B2B enterprise software, marketplace, or high-scale operational products in high-growth environments. * AI-native, with hands-on fluency in AI tools and a track record of using them to compress the path from idea to validated, shipped product change * Exceptional strategic, analytical, and quantitative skills with the ability to interpret complex data, develop clear business cases, and guide critical product decisions. * Superior leadership, communication, and executive presence, with a demonstrated ability to effectively influence and align a wide range of stakeholders from technical teams to executive leadership. * Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; an MBA or advanced degree is a plus. **Desired Skills:** * Deep understanding of digital marketplaces, particularly in B2B or e-commerce, with a focus on supply chain technology, logistics tooling, or manufacturing processes. * Experience with pricing strategy, revenue/growth strategy, or margin analytics. * Hands-on experience implementing and optimizing product strategies using AI/ML or experimentation frameworks. **Why Join Xometry?** * Play a critical role in driving profitable growth and shaping the future of manufacturing through an AI-powered platform. * Partner directly with executive leadership on high-impact strategic decisions. * Contribute to a data-driven team that is focused on transformation, aggressive growth, and building sophisticated technology solutions.
